_meta.notes: Before/after pairs verified with scripts/tells.py: before scores 60 or more, after 15 or less, and compare shows no lost or invented fact. Original text. formal = scored in formal mode (contractions and long sentences ignored).

registers.sensitive: condolences and board memos: humanizing without casualizing

pairs.title: Cold outreach email
pairs.before:
Subject: Unlocking Seamless Logistics for Northwind

Hi Marcus,

I hope this email finds you well. I wanted to reach out because Northwind Freight is doing incredible work in cold-chain delivery, and I believe our cutting-edge platform could be a game-changer for your team.

At Routely, we don't just optimize routes — we empower logistics teams to unlock their full potential. Our clients have seen a 22% reduction in late deliveries, including Bramwell Foods, which cut delays from 9% to 7% in just six weeks.

Would you be open to a quick 20-minute call on Thursday, October 9 at 2:00 pm? Please don't hesitate to reach out if you have any questions. I look forward to hearing from you!

Best regards,
Elena Cruz
pairs.after:
Subject: Late deliveries at Northwind

Hi Marcus,

Your cold-chain delivery work at Northwind Freight caught my eye. Routely optimizes routes for logistics teams, and our clients have seen a 22% reduction in late deliveries. At Bramwell Foods, delays fell from 9% to 7% in six weeks.

Could we do a quick 20-minute call on Thursday, October 9 at 2:00 pm?

Elena Cruz
pairs.changed: The throat-clearing opener, the 'game-changer' claim, the negation pivot and the 'don't hesitate' closer are gone. The subject line names the problem. Every number, name and the meeting time survived.

pairs.title: Customer apology reply
pairs.before:
Hi Tom,

Thank you for reaching out, and I sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused. We truly value your feedback, and your satisfaction is our top priority. Rest assured, we take this matter very seriously and are committed to ensuring a seamless experience for all of our valued customers.

I have reviewed your order #48213 and can confirm that the blue jacket in size L was shipped on September 12 instead of the size M you requested. Additionally, I am delighted to let you know that we have initiated a full refund of $89.95, which will be processed within 3-5 business days.

Please don't hesitate to reach out if you need further assistance. We appreciate your patience and understanding!

Warm regards,
Priya Nair
Customer Success Team
pairs.after:
Hi Tom,

I'm sorry about the mix-up. I checked order #48213: you asked for the blue jacket in size M, and we shipped size L on September 12.

We've started a full refund of $89.95. It will be processed within 3-5 business days.

Priya Nair
Customer Success Team
pairs.changed: The apology now says what went wrong instead of apologizing for 'any inconvenience'. The brand-value sentences and the offer of 'further assistance' are cut. Order number, sizes, date, amount and timeline are unchanged.

pairs.title: LinkedIn milestone post

We just passed 10,000 customers.

pairs.title: Third-person professional bio
pairs.before: Maria Alvarez is a passionate, results-driven marketing professional with over 12 years of experience in the ever-evolving digital landscape. A seasoned leader with a proven track record of driving growth and fostering innovation, she has spearheaded comprehensive campaigns for global brands such as Unilever and Nestlé. Maria holds an MBA from INSEAD and is a frequent speaker at industry events. When she's not elevating brands, she enjoys hiking, photography, and exploring new cuisines.
pairs.after: Maria Alvarez has spent more than 12 years in marketing. She has run campaigns for Unilever and Nestlé, holds an MBA from INSEAD, and speaks often at industry events. Outside work she hikes, takes photographs and tries new cuisines.
pairs.changed: Resume adjectives ('passionate', 'results-driven', 'seasoned') and the 'proven track record' claim were cut, since the employers and the degree already carry the credibility. Nothing was added.

Dear Hiring Manager,

I would like to apply for the Senior Data Analyst position at Helix Health. I have spent over seven years in healthcare analytics. pairs.title: Product blurb
pairs.before: Introducing the AeroBrew Pro — a game-changing coffee maker that seamlessly blends cutting-edge technology with timeless design. Whether you're a casual sipper or a dedicated connoisseur, AeroBrew Pro empowers you to unlock the full potential of every bean. With a 12-cup capacity, a built-in grinder, and smart Wi-Fi connectivity, it elevates your morning routine to a whole new level. Available now for just $129.
pairs.after: The AeroBrew Pro is a coffee maker with a built-in grinder, Wi-Fi and a 12-cup capacity. It's available now for $129.
pairs.changed: Every adjective claim was stripped and the specs and price were kept. When the source has no more facts than that, the honest rewrite is short. Ask the user for one real detail (a taste test, a size, a comparison) rather than inventing one.

pairs.title: Blog post intro
pairs.before: In today's fast-paced digital landscape, remote work has become more than just a trend—it's a fundamental shift in how we operate. Whether you're a seasoned manager or a first-time team lead, navigating the complexities of distributed teams can feel overwhelming. pairs.title: Internal announcement
pairs.before:
Subject: Exciting Changes Ahead!

Dear Team,

We are thrilled to announce that, effective November 3, our organization will be transitioning to a hybrid work model, fostering greater collaboration and empowering every employee to thrive. This pivotal shift underscores our commitment to flexibility and innovation in today's ever-evolving workplace.

Starting on that date, employees will be expected to work from the office on Tuesdays and Thursdays, while enjoying the flexibility to work remotely on the remaining days. Additionally, all team leads are required to submit their availability schedules to HR by October 20.

Please don't hesitate to reach out to hr@northfield.example with any questions. Together, we will navigate this exciting journey!
pairs.after:
Subject: New hybrid schedule from November 3

Hi Team,

From November 3, we're moving to a hybrid model. You'll work from the office on Tuesdays and Thursdays and can work remotely the other days.

Team leads: please send your availability schedules to HR by October 20. Questions go to hr@northfield.example.
pairs.changed: The subject line now carries the news and the date. The morale language is gone, and the two actions (office days, the team-lead deadline) are stated as instructions. All dates, days and the address are unchanged.

pairs.title: Condolence note (formal stays formal)
pairs.before:
Dear Margaret,

Please accept my heartfelt condolences on the passing of your husband, Robert. In these difficult times, it is important to remember that his legacy serves as a testament to a life well-lived. Robert's thirty years of dedicated service at Halloran & Sons touched countless lives and will continue to inspire all who knew him.

Although words cannot fully capture the depth of your loss, please know that you are not alone on this journey. The memorial service will be held on Saturday at 2 pm at St. Anne's Church, and we hope you will find comfort in the support of your loved ones.

Please don't hesitate to reach out if there is anything I can do to support you during this challenging time.

With deepest sympathy,
Thomas Whitfield
pairs.after:
Dear Margaret,

I was very sorry to hear that your husband, Robert, has died. In thirty years at Halloran & Sons he touched many lives, and he will be remembered by everyone who knew him.

I cannot say anything that makes this easier, but I want you to know that you are not alone. The memorial service will be held on Saturday at 2 pm at St. Anne's Church, and I hope you will have your family around you.

If there is anything I can do, please tell me.

With deepest sympathy,
Thomas Whitfield
pairs.changed: Humanizing is not casualizing: no contractions, no slang, still a formal note. The 'testament', 'legacy' and 'journey' language is replaced by plain sentences, and the offer of help is stated once. Names, the thirty years, the day and the time are unchanged.

pairs.title: Board memo (formal stays formal)
pairs.before:
MEMORANDUM

To: Board of Directors
From: Daniel Okafor, Chief Operating Officer
Date: 6 November 2026
Re: Q3 operational review

In light of the ever-evolving competitive landscape, it is crucial to note that the Q3 results underscore the need for a strategic realignment — a pivotal moment for our organization. Notably, revenue declined 8% to $4.2 million, highlighting the importance of streamlining our operations and fostering a culture of accountability.

Moreover, the Leeds facility, which boasts a state-of-the-art production line, experienced a 12-day outage in August, significantly impacting output. To navigate these challenges effectively, we recommend leveraging a comprehensive cost-reduction plan that could potentially save $650,000 annually.

In conclusion, the Board is encouraged to approve the proposed plan at the meeting on 18 November, ensuring a robust path forward.
pairs.after:
MEMORANDUM

To: Board of Directors
From: Daniel Okafor, Chief Operating Officer
Date: 6 November 2026
Re: Q3 operational review

Revenue in Q3 fell 8% to $4.2 million, and the results call for a change in strategy. Operations need to be simpler, and accountability needs to improve. The Leeds facility also lost 12 days of production to an outage in August, which significantly reduced output.

We recommend a cost-reduction plan that could save $650,000 annually. The Board is asked to approve it at the meeting on 18 November.
pairs.changed: Stays a board memo: formal, no contractions, no casual asides. The figure now leads the first sentence, the hedges and 'in conclusion' closer are gone, and the recommendation and the decision date are stated once each.
